title: HtmlTh
responsibility: Renders the native th element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTh.attributes
inputs.description: Native th attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTh.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native th element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTh
outputs.description: The actual native th element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
